references.text: The context of the Lord's command that one leader should offer a sacrifice each day during the altar consecrations
The fulfillment of the Lord's command where each tribal leader brings his offering one day at a time
Moses anoints and consecrates the altar, which is the background for the altar consecrations in Numbers
The dedication of the altar at the tabernacle, parallel to חֲנֻכַּת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ
Solomon's dedication of the altar in the temple, similar to the חֲנֻכַּת concept
The altar consecration under Solomon in Chronicles, parallel to the dedication offerings
The dedication of the second temple, a continuation of the tradition of חֲנֻכָּה
